entries.headline: Hardened Larp-code release qualification and prepared a private beta candidate
entries.summary: Built and exercised release-qualification checks, publication-package assembly, recovery rehearsal, scheduled maintenance, production privilege restrictions, and a private-beta candidate archive for the Manifest V3 extension. The repository also documents the packaged popup/service-worker verification flow and launch checklist.

entries.headline: Migrated the portfolio’s active publication flow to dossier v2
entries.summary: Implemented the dossier v2 publication migration, exposed verified publication status, qualified the redesigned renderer, and added evidence-bound experience stories and verified project artifacts. The work includes renderer, publication-store, database migration, browser tests, and acceptance evidence.

entries.headline: Built a browser-based Trace Explorer for Agent Tracer
entries.summary: Added the loopback Trace Explorer, session and run management, causal activity-graph projection, browser navigation, and related tests. The documented slice passively observes a shared Codex App Server and reconstructs live and historical trace activity without controlling the observed run.
